feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 22 October 2026 9:02am
items.description:
##Yesterday##

Dry with sunny spells, before heavy rain arrives overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 12°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-20, risk of 25.


##Wind Speed##

13


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or NW 15 occasionally 20 at first, backing S or SW 10-15 in the afternoon. Then backing E or NE 20-25 overnight into Friday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in any rain later. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Strong winds developing. A rain warning is under review for tonight and Friday morning due to a risk of localised flooding.


##Today##

Cloudy with heavy rain in the morning, clearing to sunny intervals and isolated showers in the afternoon.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 12°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-20, risk of 25.


##Wind Speed##

30


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

NE 20-25, occasionally 30 in the south of the area, backing NW 25-40. Decreasing W or NW 20-25 early Friday night, then W or SW 15-20 for a time, before increasing SW 20-25.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor becoming good occasionally moderate later. Hill fog at first.


##Comments##

A rain weather warning is currently under review for Thursday night into Friday morning, as heavy rain brings a risk of localised flooding. Expect strong winds, with gales in exposed spots from late morning until late afternoon, before gradually easing later.


##Tomorrow##

A band of heavy rain will arrive in the morning. This will clear to leave sunny/clear intervals alongside isolated showers from the evening.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

12-22, risk of 35 on hills.


##Wind Speed##

40


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

SW or S 20-25, increasing 25-40 through the morning, increasing W or SW 40-50 (gusts 60-70) through the evening and overnight.


##Visibility##

Falling moderate or poor in rain, becoming mostly good later. Hill fog.


##Comments##

A deep area of low pressure is expected to pass close to northern Scotland on Saturday night, bringing gale and severe gale winds, and spells of heavy rain. This could lead to some travel disruption and a risk of localised flooding in places. Potential for severe weather warnings.


##Sunday, 25 October 2026##

Sunny intervals and isolated showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 12°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0.5-2


##Wind Speed##

35


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

W 40-50 (gusts 60) at first, gradually decreasing 25-30 by the evening. Then backing SW 20-25 early in the night, before decreasing S 15-20 later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Comments##

Gales and severe gales at first, bringing travel disruption, before winds gradually ease through the period.


##Monday, 26 October 2026##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain, clearing later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10


##Wind Speed##

30


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SE 15-20, veering SW 25-40.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds and gales developing.
